name.zh: 王族一夫多妻与临时王政体系
name.en: Royal Polygamy and Provisional Succession System

periods.description: Legal and political framework allowing Lux to become provisional king and marry five queens. Old imperial polygamy for royalty and nobles remains sufficiently valid in the New Kingdom to permit the arrangement.
periods.principles: Royal marriage can include multiple consorts; Lux's hero status and Lisha's support make him a symbolic transitional king while Dist handles much administration.
periods.origin: old empire noble/royal custom continued in the New Kingdom
